name: 0.2-valid
invariant: Complete valid bundle with unchanged core rows and metrics.

name: 0.2-version
invariant: Geography and results must identify the same dataset version.

name: 0.2-id
invariant: Geography must contain the result basin ID.

name: 0.2-schema
invariant: Results must use a supported schema version.

name: 0.2-path
invariant: Prediction paths must stay inside the artifact directory.

name: 0.2-metric
invariant: RMSE must agree with the adopted prediction rows.

name: 0.2-count
invariant: Sample count must agree with adopted test rows.

name: 0.2-rejected
invariant: Rejected rows must not contain a prediction.

name: 0.2-null_reason
invariant: Undefined NSE must retain its explanatory reason.

name: 0.2-time
invariant: Target timestamps must explicitly use UTC.
